acceptance_criteria.requirement: Use a rectangular 45 mm × 35 mm board outline (dimension tolerance 0.1 mm) with two copper layers.
Use three four-pin headers J1, J2, and J3. On each header, pins 1 through 4 are +3V3, GND, SDA, SCL. Connect corresponding signals across all three headers.

Connect +3V3 through R1 = 4.7 kohm and a two-pad solder jumper JP1 in series to SDA. Connect +3V3 through R2 = 4.7 kohm and a separate two-pad solder jumper JP2 in series to SCL. Each jumper must have two isolated copper pads with a solderable gap and no default copper short.
Add C1, C2, and C3, each 100 nF between +3V3 and GND, within 5 mm of the corresponding connector centre. Mark JP1 as SDA PU and JP2 as SCL PU.
Place J1 within 5 mm of the left edge, J2 within 5 mm of the right edge, and J3 within 5 mm of the top edge, measured from footprint centres. This board contains no controller or peripheral IC.
Editable schematic and fully placed and routed PCB are supplied with readable entry files and a README documenting component choices and unresolved requirements.
Header pitch, passive packages, component pin mapping, silkscreen, board containment, copper clearance, trace widths, and complete routing satisfy the common prompt requirements.
